findings.title_ja: 未終端文字列末尾のバックスラッシュで6言語のlexerがpanicする

details.title: Trailing escape in unterminated literal panics
details.exact_trigger: Lex/Extract with bytes [34,92], no final newline; same for csharp,jsts,lua,pawn,zig
details.wrong_behavior: Escaping final byte increments cursor to len+1; later source slice/index panics instead of returning malformed-source diagnostic.
details.expected_behavior: Clamp escape advances or return len(source) on unterminated input.
details.root_cause: Escaping final byte increments cursor to len+1; later source slice/index panics instead of returning malformed-source diagnostic.
details.test_recipe: Call each lexer with exact two bytes and assert no panic and diagnostic; add backtick variant for JS.
details.relation_to_prior_fix: Distinct from N11 Python masking; affects six other lexer implementations.

findings.title_ja: root内のsymlink別名から除外対象の秘密ファイルを読み取れる

details.title: Inside-root source alias bypasses secret exclusions

details.observed_static_wrong_branch: excluded checks public.txt only; ContainedPath resolves .env inside root; ReadFile reads secret bytes and SourceFile.Path remains public.txt.
details.expected: Default secret policy should not be bypassed by alias to excluded source.
details.root_cause: Policy checks lexical alias before physical resolution, never checks physical target's relative path.
details.test_recipe: Use an OS-supported inside-root symlink fixture; ensure neither secret file nor alias content enters scanner/index. Windows link prerequisites may require junction/file-symlink variant.
details.prior_fix_relationship: A05 fixed filename case; N01 fixed outside-root physical containment. Archive explicitly left a symlink-alias scenario skipped.

findings.title_ja: index.db自体のsymlinkでroot外のDBを更新できる

findings.title_ja: global登録の強制置換で追加失敗時に旧登録を失う

findings.title_ja: 同名シンボル追加後の増分索引が古い確定関係を残す

details.title: Adding an ambiguous target preserves an obsolete resolved relation
details.reproducer: Index Go caller.go: package p; func Caller(){ Foo() }; a.go: package p; func Foo(){}. Then add b.go declaring another Foo without modifying caller.go or a.go and run incremental index.
details.observed_static_wrong_branch: RelationsForLink selects only to_handle IS NULL. IncomingRelationPaths is computed from newly added b.go, which has no previously resolved incoming edge, so caller.go is not reextracted. Its original edge to a.go survives while a full rebuild sees two Foo targets and leaves it ambiguous.
details.expected: Incremental and full rebuild must agree; addition of competing symbol should invalidate affected resolved relation.
details.root_cause: Resolved edges lose unresolved_to and affected lookup-key invalidation only selects unresolved rows.
details.test_recipe: Index initial two-file fixture, add duplicate target, compare sorted relation sets from incremental vs full rebuild.
details.prior_fix_relationship: Distinct from A03/N08: existing-target mutation and manifest mutation are fixed; new competing target is not.

findings.title_ja: 大量の再リンク条件がSQLiteの変数上限を超える

details.reproducer: Call RelationsForLink with non-full LinkScope containing more than 32766 total ChangedPaths and LookupKeys, or incrementally update enough files to generate that many distinct lookup keys.
details.observed_static_wrong_branch: One ? is appended per path/key without batching, and all parameters are passed to a single QueryContext.
details.expected: Supported repository/update size should not be limited by SQLite variable cap; batch/JSON scopes like candidate retrieval.
details.root_cause: Unbounded IN lists in relation linking.
details.test_recipe: Construct deterministic LinkScope above driver SQLITE_LIMIT_VARIABLE_NUMBER, assert lookup succeeds and returns expected relation. Then add scaled incremental integration case.
details.prior_fix_relationship: Scoped candidate retrieval batches already exist; relation-link scope remains unbatched.

findings.title_ja: C#のverbatim文字列の末尾バックスラッシュが後続メソッドを隠す

details.expected_behavior: Use literal-kind-specific quoting rules.
